name: Red Lamp
tagline: A robot desk lamp reworked into a companion you can talk to.
problem: People alone want something present and responsive, not another chatbot window.
solution: Built from a lamp-robot kit with 3D-printed parts and a Raspberry Pi, adapted for conversation and companionship.
demo_moment: Team-described: talk to the lamp and it responds and moves.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “LeLamp: Hack the Human-Robot Experience” among 160 submissions.
Assembled and ran the robot from scratch within the event.

lessons: In a hardware sponsor track, getting the kit fully working is most of the battle.
